**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] The user has been analyzing their social media performance.
- [FACT] The user has grown their followers on Instagram significantly since the start of the year.
- [FACT] The user started the year with 250 followers on Instagram.
- [PREFERENCE] The user is curious about what kind of content is currently trending on Instagram.
- [PREFERENCE] The user has been experimenting with Instagram Stories and Reels.
- [PREFERENCE] The user has seen a good engagement rate from their Instagram Stories and Reels.
- [PREFERENCE] The user is interested in using hashtags effectively on Instagram.
- [PREFERENCE] The user is considering running a contest or giveaway to increase engagement.
- [EVENT] The user has been focusing on increasing engagement through regular posting and interacting with others.
- [ASSISTANT] The assistant provided insights on popular content types on Instagram, including Reels, authenticity, visual storytelling, interactive content, wellness, sustainable living, influencer collaborations, educational content, humor, and consistency.
- [ASSISTANT] The assistant advised the user on how to choose the right hashtags and how many to use per post, recommending a mix of relevant, specific, and popular hashtags, and suggesting using 5-15 hashtags per post.
- [ASSISTANT] The assistant provided specific strategies to boost engagement rates, including asking questions, using polls, hosting contests, and engaging with the audience.
- [ASSISTANT] The assistant discussed the pros and cons of requiring followers to tag a friend or share a post to enter a contest, emphasizing the importance of clear rules and relevant prizes.
